visual.name: plumeShapeGauge
visual.description: Shape gauge with the Plume Studio look: any shape fills up with color to show a percentage (a barrel 50% full of burgundy for 50%). 153 built-in shapes including 22 containers that fill only their inside (wine glass, thermometer, bottle, battery), or your own pasted SVG; vertical, horizontal, circular (start angle) or radial fill, level or exact-area filling; single color, thresholds, gradient; target and previous-period marks; wave surface, stacked layers, pictograms; one shape per category; play axis.
